info.name: Shyft Customer Authentication > Email Customer > SetupActions API

items.docs:
All supported actions types: 
["action_cancel", "action_update_app", "action_logout", "action_switch_location", "action_update_cache", "action_goto_screen", "action_goto_page", "action_call_api", "action_prompt", "action_sso_logout", "action_restart_app"]

For test purpose, you can supply `sample=true` parameter to get samples actions. Sample actions will not be erased upon visit.

Many actions are user specific.

Meta data only show when supplied the associated `location_id` parameter.
